narr: A complex of storms organized across northern MS during the early afternoon of the 7th and produced a round of wind damage across portions of northeast MS.
ev: Heavy rainfall between 4 and 5 inches fell across Starkville. Flash flooding occurred across the area with water entering homes along Friar Tuck, Sherwood, and Willow Bend roads.
